steps.text: Wine's controller driver now sees gamepads through SDL only, instead of the Mac's raw HID path as well. Symptom this fixes when it applies, a controller that a game does not recognise or that shows up twice. Restart the environment after applying so the driver reloads. First reported working on Elden Ring by a user who set these two registry values by hand (highball-db#228).

lastVerified.result: Applies cleanly to a fresh environment: HKCU\Software\Wine\WineBus gets DisableHidraw=1 and Enable SDL=1 (reg query confirms both). No gamepad here, so the controller effect itself is the reporter's observation on Elden Ring (highball-db#228), not measured by the maintainer.
